title: Stalkwise Tor dimensions are locally uniformly bounded
statement: Let $X,Y$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], with $Y$ Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth], and $f:X\to Y$ locally of finite type. Suppose that every source local ring has finite Tor dimension over its target local ring [def-pc-perfect-morphism]. For every $x\in X$ there are an open $U\subseteq X$ with $x\in U$ and an integer $d\geq0$ such that for every $y\in U$, every $\mathcal O_{Y,f(y)}$-module $M$, and every integer $j>d$, $\operatorname{Tor}^{\mathcal O_{Y,f(y)}}_j(\mathcal O_{X,y},M)=0$. The module structure uses the stalk homomorphism of $f$; the same $d$ works for all $y\in U$ and all $M$. No quasi-compactness of $X$ is assumed.

source.place: Tag 069C, lemma-check-perfect-stalks, implication (3) to (2) and (1) to (2); Cohomology Tag 09U9; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/069C

proof.text: For x choose an affine target open U containing f(x). Choose an affine source open V containing x inside the preimage of U, using Mathlib exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset twice. Apply affineSections_finiteTorDimension_of_stalkwise to the actual section map f.appLE U V e to obtain a finite Tor bound d for the coordinate algebra.

Apply affineSections_torBound_stalk with this same d and coordinate bound. It gives vanishing for every y in V and every target-stalk test module above d. Use V and its membership proof at x as the neighbourhood witnesses. No finite subcover of X is used.

lean.statement:
theorem stalkTorDimension_locally_uniform
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (hperfect : HasStalkwiseFiniteTorDimension f) :
    ∀ x : X, ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧ ∃ d : ℕ,
      ∀ y : X, y ∈ U → ∀ M : ModuleCat.{u} (Y.presheaf.stalk (f y)),
        ∀ j : ℕ, d < j →
          IsZero (((Tor' (ModuleCat.{u} (Y.presheaf.stalk (f y))) j).obj
            ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (f.stalkMap y).hom).obj
              (ModuleCat.of (X.presheaf.stalk y) (X.presheaf.stalk y)))).obj M)
